# RegNet

**Category:** CNN · **Code:**
[`timm/models/regnet.py`](https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models/blob/main/timm/models/regnet.py) ·
**Architectures:** 36 · **Pretrained weights:** 65 (60 with ImageNet-1k results)

RegNetX and RegNetY networks from the regular network design spaces, RegNetZ from "Fast and Accurate Model Scaling", and
`timm` additions such as the pre-activation RegNetV. Includes weights from pycls, torchvision and VISSL (SEER).

## Papers

* [Designing Network Design Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2003.13678)
* [Fast and Accurate Model Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2103.06877)
* [Self-supervised Pretraining of Visual Features in the Wild](https://arxiv.org/abs/2103.01988)
* [Revisiting Weakly Supervised Pre-Training of Visual Perception Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2201.08371)

## Usage

See the [Quickstart](../quickstart) for loading pretrained weights, image preprocessing and fine-tuning, and [Feature
Extraction](../feature_extraction) for using the models as backbones.

```py
>>> import timm
>>> model = timm.create_model('regnetx_064.pycls_in1k', pretrained=True)
>>> data_config = timm.data.resolve_model_data_config(model)
```

## Pretrained weights

Top-1 is ImageNet-1k validation accuracy from
[`results-imagenet.csv`](https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models/blob/main/results/results-imagenet.csv) at
the listed eval size, - if the weight has no ImageNet-1k result (e.g. pretraining or image-text weights). Classes is the
size of the pretrained classifier, none for weights without one.

Weights are grouped by source: the paper or origin given in the pretrained config, else a Hub organization other than
`timm`, else the first part of the pretrained tag (`architecture.tag`). Sources with a single weight are listed under
other.
